SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN existing.external_file_id IS NOT NULL THEN false
    WHEN same_content.external_file_id IS NOT NULL THEN false
    ELSE true
  END AS should_process,
  $1::text AS file_id,
  $2::text AS version_key,
  $3::text AS file_name,
  $4::text AS folder_id,
  $5::text AS folder_name,
  NULLIF($6::text, '')::timestamptz AS modified_time,
  NULLIF($7::text, '') AS md5_checksum,
  $8::date AS cutoff_day,
  $9::date AS candidate_day,
  $10::text AS cutoff_reason,
  NULLIF($11::text, '') AS latest_observation_et,
  COALESCE(existing.observation_count, same_content.observation_count, 0) AS prior_observation_count
FROM (SELECT 1) seed
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT external_file_id, observation_count
  FROM health_ingested_files
  WHERE source_system = 'health_sync'
    AND external_file_id = $1
    AND version_key = $2
    AND status = 'processed'
  LIMIT 1
) existing ON true
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT external_file_id, observation_count
  FROM health_ingested_files
  WHERE source_system = 'health_sync'
    AND folder_id = $4
    AND file_name = $3
    AND md5_checksum = NULLIF($7::text, '')
    AND status = 'processed'
  LIMIT 1
) same_content ON true

WITH payload AS (
  SELECT * FROM jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb) AS x(
    metric_type text, original_type text, start_time text, end_time text,
    value_numeric double precision, value_text text, unit text,
    source_name text, external_id text, raw_payload_json text
  )
), source_rows AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT source_name FROM payload
), sources AS (
  INSERT INTO health_sources
    (source_system, source_name, source_type, device_name, external_source_id, metadata_json)
  SELECT 'health_sync', source_name, 'health_sync_google_drive_export', NULL, source_name, '{}'
  FROM source_rows
  ON CONFLICT (source_system, source_name, external_source_id)
  DO UPDATE SET source_type = EXCLUDED.source_type
  RETURNING id, source_name
), inserted AS (
  INSERT INTO health_observations_raw
    (source_id, metric_type, original_type, start_time, end_time,
     value_numeric, value_text, unit, source_name, device_name,
     external_id, raw_payload_json)
  SELECT s.id, p.metric_type, p.original_type, p.start_time, p.end_time,
         p.value_numeric, p.value_text, p.unit, p.source_name, NULL,
         p.external_id, p.raw_payload_json
  FROM payload p JOIN sources s USING (source_name)
  ON CONFLICT (source_id, original_type, external_id) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING id
), ledger AS (
  INSERT INTO health_ingested_files
    (source_system, external_file_id, version_key, file_name, folder_id,
     folder_name, modified_time, md5_checksum, status,
     observation_count, inserted_count, processed_at, error_text)
  VALUES ('health_sync', $2, $3, $4, $5, $6,
          NULLIF($7, '')::timestamptz, NULLIF($8, ''), 'processed',
          jsonb_array_length($1::jsonb), (SELECT count(*) FROM inserted), now(), NULL)
  ON CONFLICT (source_system, external_file_id, version_key)
  DO UPDATE SET status='processed', observation_count=EXCLUDED.observation_count,
                inserted_count=EXCLUDED.inserted_count,
                processed_at=now(), error_text=NULL
  RETURNING observation_count, inserted_count
)
SELECT observation_count, inserted_count, $4::text AS file_name FROM ledger

WITH latest AS (
  SELECT max(o.start_time::timestamptz) AS latest_observation
  FROM health_observations_raw o
  JOIN health_sources s ON s.id = o.source_id
  WHERE s.source_system = 'health_sync'
    AND s.source_name = 'Health Sync / Health Connect'
    AND o.raw_payload_json LIKE ('%"folderName":"' || $1 || '"%')
)
SELECT $1::text AS folder_name,
       $2::text AS folder_id,
       COALESCE(
         (latest_observation AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')::date,
         (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')::date - 30
       ) AS cutoff_day,
       CASE WHEN latest_observation IS NULL
         THEN '30-day safety floor'
         ELSE 'latest successful Health Connect observation'
       END AS cutoff_reason,
       (latest_observation AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')::text AS latest_observation_et
FROM latest
